title: Margaret V NDE 5358/4844
content:
5358: I was brought into the ER by ambulance. I don't remember very much. I do remember being in the hospital and being brought into a room. I was there only a few minutes, or so I thought. I remember being aware that my chest was feeling different from usual. I also remember that, at the time, I was wondering if it was my body that I was looking down on because I was also looking around and seeing no one. I said, 'Um hum, I don't know where everyone is but something is happening here. I don't feel right.' Next thing I see is that I am in a dark room. It wasn't round, it wasn't square; it was just very, very warm, very beautiful, and very, very black.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Heart attack Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) My heart had quit. | Yes Heart attack 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' Heart quit.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Uncertain I lost awareness of my body | No I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness I could feel my heart beating funny and my head was aching, but I was alert, very alert. | Normal consciousness and alertness As above.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I could feel my heart beating funny and my head was aching, but I was alert, very alert. | Just before going into the black room and right after the doctor waking to tell me that I was going for surgery.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I could see the black but I didn't reach up to touch the blackness. I just knew I was in a safe, warm place.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt very happy and very, very warm for the first time in hours. | Peacefulness and calmness.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will

elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes I didn't know how to explain to others what the warmth was like in the black room, during and after, without them looking at me like I was nuts. | Yes Only to people who didn't understand what I was trying to explain.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes Sometimes I have a sense that a person is letting me know that they are not going to be here on this Earth much longer and, whenever that happens, they have usually passed within the month. I usually see it in their eyes. | No
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: I am still trying to find out why I had that experience at that time. I feel that there is a reason and I feel very lucky to still be alive and to be able to see my children and my grandchildren. | Was sacred of death before - but am ready to go when it is my time.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes The very next day, I told a nurse and then I told my family. | Yes Two days.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real Right away, I saw the experience as 'definitely real.' I viewed it as a gift and I felt privileged that I was able to share my experience. I still do.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real I still see the experience as 'definitely real.' I used to be scared to leave, but now I feel I had the experience just to show me that there is nothing to be scared of; that after death, it is more tranquil than anything we have ever known here on this Earth.
